skills.skill_desc:
<font color="a6aafb">Bear's Blessing</font>: Masha has 3 HP bars, each inheriting 50% of her Equipment HP bonuses. Each time an HP bar breaks, she removes control effects on herself and blocks one instance of damage. Dealing damage to enemy heroes or creeps builds <font color="a6aafb">Feral</font>, which converts into HP after she leaves combat.
<font color="a6aafb">Power of Wildness</font>: When Masha's skills damage an enemy hero, a <font color="a6aafb">Wound</font> appears on a random side of the target. Breaking a <font color="a6aafb">Wound</font> with a Basic Attack puts her into the <font color="a6aafb">Feral</font> state.
<font color="a6aafb">Feral State</font>: For 3s, Masha gains 15<font color="ffe63c"> (+1*Hero Level)</font>% Resilience, Attack Speed, and Movement Speed. Her next 3 Basic Attacks become fan-shaped claw strikes, dealing extra <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> equal to 3<font color="fba51f"> (+0.5% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="ffe63c">(+0.2*Hero Level)</font>% <font color="26e407"><1005></font> to enemies in the area (not against Turrets) and recovering 4<font color="ffe63c"> (+0.4*Hero Level)</font>% HP.
[C8Breaking another <font color="a6aafb">Wound</font> during the <font color="a6aafb">Feral</font> state refreshes the state's duration. Up to 6 claw strikes can be stored.]

Masha releases energy forward, dealing 250<font color="fba51f"> (+55% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in its path. It deals 150% damage to minions.

Masha dashes in the target direction, dealing 120<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and reducing enemy heroes' Movement Speed by 50% for 1s on hit.

[C8Whenever an HP bar is depleted, the cooldown of <font color="a6aafb">Claw Strike</font> resets.]

Masha charges toward an enemy hero, dealing 300<font color="26e407"> (+50% Extra Max HP)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and stunning them for 1s while knocking back nearby enemies.
